Who they sell to – missing in the corpus

The dataset does not contain buyer information for Kazakh uranium. A source that would settle this would be:

Off-take and supply agreements disclosed in the producers’ annual reports and regulatory filings.
Customs and trade statistics (e.g., UN Comtrade) showing export destinations.
Procurement disclosures from major nuclear utilities and fuel-cycle companies.
